signal: Centrical launched AI Role-Play simulations and expanded its MegAI coach, cited to accelerate time to proficiency by 30%

email.body1:
Malcolm, saw Centrical launch AI Role-Play and expand MegAI, with time to proficiency up about 30 percent.

Momentum like that usually opens more accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Centrical off your product and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Malcolm, quick follow-up for Centrical.

With new AI capabilities to take to market, the pipeline target moves faster than headcount can. Most BD leaders don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Centrical needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Malcolm, last bit of proof for Centrical.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Centrical's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise-SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Malcolm, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Bringing new AI features to a global market is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your business development motion? I'll tailor it to Centrical either way.
